Anthony Hope, The Prisoner of Zenda.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/anthony-hope/the-prisoner-of-zenda

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Anthony Hope, the author, died 1933 (citizenship: United Kingdom, United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland).

First publication of the text used: 1894 (SE colophon: 'The Prisoner of Zenda was published in 1894 by Anthony Hope.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1894, before 1931. A published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 1989.
- Country of origin (the country of first publication is not named in the facts; possible countries: United Kingdom, Ireland, United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India, South Africa): each of these countries has a term of life + 70 years or less. The last person to die did so in 1933, so the work is public domain in each of them from 1 January 2004.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
